answer.claimed: The lab requests repayment under NIH/NIAID grant R21AI182745 (Investigating ploidy modulation as a strategy to improve antibiotic activity) for 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31, totaling $7,060. Personnel, $5,130: a research technician at 60% effort for 1 pay period, $2,880; a graduate researcher at 50% effort for 1 pay period, $2,250. Equipment service, $1,290: rq-036, ultra-low freezer service contract, $1,290, keeping isolate stocks at -80 C. Core facility services, $640: rq-038, genomics core sequencing run for 24 isolates, $640, confirming resistance genes.
answer.leftOut: Under the rule "held spending is left out", rq-037 (Mueller-Hinton broth, $1,460) is excluded because invoice inv-037 is on hold over a billing mismatch (24 bottles billed, 12 ordered). pay-R21-2026-05-3 (research associate salary, $2,600) is excluded because the person is charged 110% effort across two grants until the grant manager fixes it.
